hypothesis: Response insufficient for the stress (low NRF2 tone or reserve)
what_supports: NFE2L2 and NQO1 transcripts lower in W01, NFE2L2 lower in W02; ROS higher in fly and late-passage MEF
what_refutes: NQO1 higher in W02; HMOX1 and SRXN1 higher in W01; early-passage MEF targets higher
what_separates: NRF2 nuclear protein, NQO1 activity and ROS before and after a fixed challenge, per genotype and clone
transfer_note: low basal NRF2 is not needed to justify an activation experiment

hypothesis: Response already induced but functionally insufficient
what_supports: HMOX1, SRXN1, GSR higher; MEF early redox transcripts higher; P47T Hmox1/Srxn1 up
what_refutes: no ROS or function deficit shown; early MEF ROS not raised (compensation could be effective)
what_separates: induced target activity plus a functional deficit that further NRF2 raising corrects (or does not)
transfer_note: already-high NRF2 does not prove a ceiling or harm from more activation

hypothesis: Benefit mediated by astrocytes or another compartment
what_supports: E07-E09: ARE reporter activity in astrocytes, neuronal gene change depends on astrocyte Nrf2; P47T target score tracks astrocytes
what_refutes: neuronal Wwox deletion alone gives the phenotype (W09) but that does not exclude non-autonomous rescue; no WWOX data on astrocytic NRF2
what_separates: genotype-by-compartment co-culture: WWOX-null neurons with NFE2L2-intact or NFE2L2-null astrocytes
transfer_note: precedent is another system and an oxidative-death endpoint

hypothesis: Differences between cell types or developmental phases
what_supports: organoid radial-glia and astrocyte composition; ages differ (2 weeks to adult); progenitor gate failed in W02
what_refutes: not tested; no stage-resolved NRF2 datum
what_separates: same readout at defined stages of one differentiation, with composition counts
transfer_note: parvalbumin and oligodendrocyte endpoints: keep cell loss, marker reduction, maturation and survival apart

what_supports: electrophiles act on NF-kB, JNK, HCAR2 (monomethyl fumarate), GAPDH; residual effects reported in Nrf2-null settings
what_refutes: genetic NFE2L2 control abolishing the effect (E08 shows this for tBHQ in another system)
what_separates: NFE2L2 loss with rescue for each compound, KEAP1 knockdown as the genetic comparator, NAC as one redox comparator only
transfer_note: a residual effect in the absence of NRF2 needs an explanation and does not identify the off-target

what_supports: no WWOX-system datum; omaveloxolone off-NRF2 window at hundreds of nM; a high-NRF2 state does not prove harm
what_refutes: a rescue of viability or network activity that is NFE2L2-dependent
what_separates: vehicle versus activation with viability and composition controls, per genotype
transfer_note: precedents from acquired epilepsy, ischaemia, demyelination and cardiac disease are transfers, not WWOX results
